title: "First time? How to play" in the room lobby, in the owner's words
problem: The first-game tips are off in online games, so a new player invited to a room gets no help; 43 of 102 games started were online and most games stop on Day 1.
scope: A panel in a private room lobby for a player who has never finished a game, with the owner's text (run your stall, the daily routine, Market Days, three things to remember), numbers from the game data
Got it (remembered) and All the rules (opens How to play); never blocks Ready or Start

acceptance.text: npm run verify passes, with a test of the text, who sees it and Got it

approval.evidence: Owner, 2026-11-15, after the drafts: his own text for the panel, then "use this".
